The Sun is a large sphere of high temperature gas. An extremely large quantity of energy
radiates from the Sun into space every second.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
A gardener stores water in a large, cylindrical metal drum. The drum is painted black
and has no lid. On a bright, sunny day, the water evaporates quickly and the water level
in the drum falls.

mark_scheme.label: 5(b)(i)
mark_scheme.text: (accept thinner, narrower(at top), ignore reference to lid)

content.html: Suggest how, by using a drum of a different shape, the gardener can reduce the quantity of water lost by evaporation.

mark_scheme.text:
wax/level of water in vessel
source of heat e.g. Sun/radiant heater (condone light bulb/Bunsen burner)
action: (fill cans with water and) measure temperature rise or wax melts or
compare volumes of water
observation: water in black can (better absorber) has greater temperature
increase / wax melts first / less water
note: emission experiment gains max. 2

content.html: The gardener is told that, by painting the drum white, he can reduce the quantity of radiation absorbed and so reduce the rate of evaporation.
content.text: The gardener is told that, by painting the drum white, he can reduce the quantity of radiation absorbed and so reduce the rate of evaporation.

content.html: Describe an experiment to show that black surfaces are better absorbers of radiation than white surfaces. You may include a diagram.
